# `trait`

Anything an entity has that changes what it is or can do: a feature, a mutation, a perk, a blessing, a curse, a drug, a stun, a stance (06 §5). What it confers lasts as long as it does.

## Fields

Besides these, a definition takes the [keys every definition carries](README.md#keys-every-definition-carries).

- `name` ([text](../values.md#texts), or `null`; optional): What a reader calls it.
- `description` ([text](../values.md#texts), or `null`; optional): What a closer look says of it.
- `seat` (one of `"body"`, `"mind"` ([`Seat`](#seat)); optional): `body` or `mind`: which it stays with when they part (06 §8.2). Carried until minds move.
- `modifiers` (list of object [`ModifierDef`](#modifierdef); optional): Attribute modifiers while it lasts, once for each stack.
- `rates` (list of object [`RateDef`](#ratedef); optional): Pool rates while it lasts, times its stacks.
- `tags` (list of string; optional): Tags its holder carries while it lasts.
- `grants` (list of [`GrantDef`](#grantdef); optional): Actions its holder may use (03 §6; 08 §5.1). Carried until the action runtime offers them.
- `abilities` (list of string; optional): Abilities conferred while it lasts and is not dormant (08 §3.3), by id as written: each instance is a source of each (`crate::ability`).
- `ability_params` (list of object [`ParamModifierDef`](#parammodifierdef); optional): Changes to the parameters of its holder's abilities while it lasts and is not dormant (08 §4.2), once for each stack: each names an ability or a tag, a parameter, and `add` and `mul`.
- `channels` (object, id of a [`channel`](channel.md) → whole number; optional): Channel slots added (a positive count) or disabled (a negative one) while it lasts (03 §6.2). Read by `channel_change` for the action runtime.
- `senses` (list of string; optional): Senses added or altered (15), by name as written. Carried until perception is built.
- `rules` (list of [`eoc`](eoc.md), by id or [written in place](../values.md#inline-definitions); optional): Rules attached to its holder while it lasts (05 §9.3).
- `on_apply` ([list of effects](../values.md#effects); optional): Effects run when it is added, with the holder as `self`.
- `on_remove` ([list of effects](../values.md#effects); optional): Effects run when it ends, however it ends, with the holder as `self`.
- `duration` ([time](../units.md#time) in `s`, or `null`; optional): If given, it ends by itself after this much of its holder's time (03 §9). Above zero.
- `while_unloaded` (one of `"pause"`, `"elapse"` ([`WhileUnloaded`](#whileunloaded)); optional): What its duration does while its holder is out of the simulation. Default `pause`.
- `stacking` (one of `"none"`, `"refresh"`, `"stack"` ([`Stacking`](#stacking)); optional): What adding it again does. Default `none`.
- `max` (whole number, 0 or more, or `null`; optional): The most stacks it reaches, for `"stacking": "stack"`. Left out, `MAX_STACKS`.
- `group` (string, or `null`; optional): Traits of one group exclude each other: adding one removes the others. Stances, forms, moods.
- `while` ([condition](../values.md#conditions), or `null`; optional): While this does not hold, the trait is dormant and confers nothing. About the holder, `self`. Worked out when a trait of the holder is added or removed until reactive expressions (05 §7.5) keep it current.
- `bound` (`true` or `false`; optional): Whether, given by an ability, it ends when that ability does (08 §7.3). Carried until abilities are built.
- `look` (string, or `null`; optional): How its holder appears while it lasts (12 §4.4), as written. Reported with `trait_added` and `trait_removed`.
- `goals` (list of string; optional): Goals added to its holder's mind (09 §3), by id as written. Carried until minds decide.
- `weights` (object, name → number; optional): Changes to the weights its holder's mind scores goals by (09 §3). Carried until minds decide.

<a id="seat"></a>
### `Seat`

Which goes where when a mind and a body part company (06 §8.2).

One of:

- `"body"`: Stays with the body.
- `"mind"`: Leaves with the mind.

<a id="modifierdef"></a>
### `ModifierDef`

An attribute modifier an item confers on whoever holds it in a grasp or wears it (06 §9.1, §4.1).

- `attr` (id of a [`attribute`](attribute.md); **required**): The attribute.
- `add` (number; optional): Added to the attribute's base. Default 0.
- `mul` (number; optional): Multiplied in after every addition. Default 1.

<a id="ratedef"></a>
### `RateDef`

A pool rate a trait applies while it lasts (06 §4.2): what the pool gains in a second of its owner's time, negative to drain. A trait with stacks applies it once for each stack.

- `pool` (id of a [`pool`](pool.md); **required**): The pool.
- `rate` (number; **required**): Per second of the owner's time.

<a id="grantdef"></a>
### `GrantDef`

An action a trait makes available (08 §5.1), with what using it costs. Carried until the action runtime offers granted actions.

In data: an action's id, or `{ "action": id, "cost": { pool: expression }, "cooldown": time, "at_rank": int, "if": condition }`.

Written as an action's id, or a grant with an `action`.

Takes:

- a string: id of a [`action`](action.md)
- an object: object [`GrantObject`](#grantobject)

<a id="parammodifierdef"></a>
### `ParamModifierDef`

A change to a parameter of abilities (08 §4.2), made by whatever lists it while that lasts: a trait (its `ability_params`) or an active ability (its `always`). It names one ability or a tag, never both, and one parameter.

- `ability` (string, or `null`; optional): The ability whose parameter it changes, as written.
- `tag` (string, or `null`; optional): Or: every ability with this tag.
- `param` (string; **required**): The parameter.
- `add` (number; optional): Added to the parameter's value. Default 0.
- `mul` (number; optional): Multiplied in after every addition. Default 1.

<a id="whileunloaded"></a>
### `WhileUnloaded`

What a trait's duration does while its owner is out of the simulation (03 §9).

One of:

- `"pause"`: It stands still, and goes on where it stopped when the owner returns.
- `"elapse"`: The time that passed is taken off when the owner returns; a trait whose time has run out then ends at once.

<a id="stacking"></a>
### `Stacking`

What adding a trait an entity already has from the same giver does (06 §5).

One of:

- `"none"`: Nothing: the trait is had once.
- `"refresh"`: Its duration starts again.
- `"stack"`: It gains a stack, up to its `max`, and its duration starts again.

<a id="grantobject"></a>
### `GrantObject`

The object form of a grant.

- `action` (id of a [`action`](action.md); **required**): The action the trait makes available. Required.
- `cost` (object, name → string; optional): What starting it spends: by pool, an expression of the amount.
- `cooldown` ([time](../units.md#time) in `s`, or `null`; optional): Local time of the holder before it can be used again.
- `at_rank` (whole number, 0 or more, or `null`; optional): The least rank of the ability that gives the trait.
- `if` (string, or `null`; optional): A further condition that must hold for it to be offered.
